full_judgment: 2. Rules were issued upon the respondents to show cause as to why they should not be directed to absorb the petitioners as lecturers in their respective Departments of the Lal monirhat Government college or any other government College and why the respondents should not be directed to give effect to the appointment of the petitioners with all wages and benefits as lecturers from the date of nationalization of the Lalmonirhat Decree College on 01.11.1984.
